$comment: Validates docs/spec/_source/glossary-tables.json, the layout of docs/spec/_assets/tbl-glossary.md (CR-857 step 2). The names themselves stay in docs/spec/_source/glossary.json; this manuscript holds every line and cell that is not a name.

The block shape is the one docs/development-rules/manuscript-schemas/settings.schema.json gives settings.json (kind, lines / id, caption, columns, separator, blank_before_header, rows), so the two generated tables print in one house style.
English is the primary text and Japanese its translation, as in glossary.schema.json: every description has a sibling x-description-ja.
The schema sees the SHAPE. docs/spec/_source/glossary_json_to_md.py refuses what JSON Schema cannot say: a placeholder naming no term, a row id written twice, a row missing a cell of its columns.
title: The glossary layout manuscript
description: The layout of docs/spec/_assets/tbl-glossary.md: its prose lines in document order, and its tables T-101 to T-106 with captions, columns and rows. A name cell holds placeholders such as {written:taskType}, which the generator fills from docs/spec/_source/glossary.json. The rows of table T-109 live in docs/spec/_source/icons.json; its block here holds the caption and the columns only.
x-description-ja: docs/spec/_assets/tbl-glossary.md の配置: 文書の順の散文の行と、表 T-101〜T-106 の見出し・列・行。名の欄は {written:taskType} のような置き換えの印を持ち、生成器が docs/spec/_source/glossary.json から名を埋める。表 T-109 の行は docs/spec/_source/icons.json が持ち、ここのその表のブロックは見出しと列だけを持つ。

$comment.description: Notes for whoever edits this manuscript, one line per note. Not printed.
$comment.x-description-ja: この原稿を直す人への注記。1 行に 1 つ。印字しない。

blocks.description: The document in print order. Dispatched on kind, as settings.schema.json does.
blocks.x-description-ja: 印字の順の文書。settings.schema.json と同じく kind で分ける。

language.description: Text in one language or more; ja is the edition printed today.
language.x-description-ja: 1 つ以上の言語の文。今印字するのは ja。

plain.description: A string that belongs to no language: a blank line, a rule row, a name cell of placeholders. It admits no Japanese character, so prose cannot be left bare.
plain.x-description-ja: どの言語にも属さない文字列: 空の行・罫の行・置き換えの印の名の欄。日本語の字を許さないので、散文を裸で置けない。

cell.description: One printed cell: a plain string or a language dictionary. Either may hold placeholders {written:KEY}, {label:KEY}, {owned:KEY}, {key:KEY} or {ja:KEY}, which print a name of the term KEY of glossary.json.
cell.x-description-ja: 印字する 1 つの欄: 言語の無い文字列か、言語の辞書。どちらも置き換えの印 {written:キー}・{label:キー}・{owned:キー}・{key:キー}・{ja:キー} を持ってよく、印は glossary.json の語のキーの名を印字する。

prose.description: Lines printed verbatim, in order: headings, the notes between tables, blank lines.
prose.x-description-ja: そのまま順に印字する行: 見出し・表のあいだの注記・空の行。

field.description: The key the cells of this column are stored under. name is the column that holds the name of the term.
field.x-description-ja: この列の欄を持つキー。name は語の名を持つ列。

frame.description: What every table block carries: the table number, the caption, the columns, the alignment row verbatim and the line printed between the caption and the header.
frame.x-description-ja: 表のブロックがみな持つもの: 表の番号・見出し・列・揃えの行（そのまま）・見出しと列名の行のあいだに印字する行。

table.description: A table of names (T-101 to T-106): one row object per row, keyed by the column fields.
table.x-description-ja: 名の表（T-101〜T-106）: 1 行に 1 つの行の物。列のキーで欄を持つ。

icons.description: The frame of table T-109. Its rows are the objects of docs/spec/_source/icons.json, named by source.
icons.x-description-ja: 表 T-109 の枠。行は source が指す docs/spec/_source/icons.json の物である。

unspacedCells.description: Fields whose cell closes on the pipe with no space before it, kept so the printed table stayed byte-identical to the hand-written one at the switch (CR-857 step 2).
unspacedCells.x-description-ja: 欄の閉じの縦線の前に空白を置かない欄のキー。切り替えのとき、印字した表を手書きの表とバイト単位で同じに保つために持つ（CR-857 の段 2）。
